findings.note: _expected_staging_root_real resolves specs/<feature> itself before appending .resolver-staging, so a symlinked feature directory becomes the trusted base and _staging_area_contained returns true for an external staging tree. The recovery scan can consequently traverse an external TRANSACTION.json and _discard_batch can recursively delete its external batch directory, violating the fixed write-set boundary and leaving the parent-symlink variant of the recovery-path deletion vulnerability open.
